scope: Source-only native input review; no production edits, browser runs, or performance acceptance claims

findings.operation: focus then setSelectionRange with preserved/clamped selectionDirection
findings.frequencyFromSource: Only restoreTypingFocus calls: focus-prompt click and requestAnimationFrame after resume. Not ordinary accepted insertion or each render.
findings.note: Preserves WebKit blur selection. A no-op guard here is not supported as a solution for a sustained typing latency regression.

findings.frequencyFromSource: Called on non-deletion beforeinput, focus/select, composition start, and blocked deletion. It returns before native selection reads when disabled, draft, composing, or missing input. setSelectionRange occurs only when start/end violates editable floor.
findings.note: Learn passes draft:true. Main typing normal in-bound insertions read selection but do not set it.

findings.operation: native value assignment and collapsed selection after accepted deletion
findings.frequencyFromSource: After a nonzero accepted deletion or reopening previous incorrect submitted word. Draft mode writes empty value and skips setSelectionRange.
findings.note: Zero deletion requests return before this write. Retain canonical text and grapheme-to-UTF16 offset semantics.

findings.frequencyFromSource: Ordinary commit writes only if native value differs from next.finalText. Controlled React state is then updated.
findings.note: Unconditional explicit assignments are in special no-op, ignored empty-space, rejected transfer, and consumed composition echo branches at lines461,486,847,855. They are not normal accepted insertions.

findings.frequencyFromSource: Ordinary committed insertion calls setDraft empty; composition keeps draft until compositionend. Explicit event.currentTarget.value assignments at502 and512 handle deletion fallback and rejected transfer only.
findings.note: Normal draft clearing is performed through React controlled-value restoration; do not infer zero native setter traffic from the absence of explicit assignments.

findings.frequencyFromSource: Main typing mount/autoFocus changes use preventScroll. Pause-status transition focuses resume and scrolls stage. Learn new session/reset and explicit stage click/resume focus input; Escape blurs. Learn desktop autofocus depends on session.controller, not each snapshot.
findings.note: No per-accepted-character explicit focus or scrollIntoView found.

findings.operation: visible caret geometry and stage scroll
findings.frequencyFromSource: Layout effects measure after cursor/finalText/target/status/focus/geometry dependencies. Native geometry read fallback populates a bounded forward cache. Stage scrollTop write is guarded by cached desired scrollTop. Resize/fonts/document theme changes invalidate cache.
findings.note: This is visible stage scrolling, not textarea internal scroll. Trace association is required before attributing program CPU or delay.

findings.frequencyFromSource: Both source textareas are full width/full height positioned overlays. No wrap attribute is specified. Main input is transparent; Learn is opacity0; Learn draft is normally empty between commits. No 1px textarea rule found in reviewed applicable CSS.
findings.note: Actual computed native textarea geometry/scroll extents are UNVERIFIED by this source-only review. Native browser editing can still scroll internally without JS setters. Do not repeat a blind nowrap/GPU CSS prototype.

findings.frequencyFromSource: React captures the textarea prototype value descriptor and defines an own value accessor delegating to that captured setter. updateWrapper at2327 already checks newValue differs before setting node.value; defaultValue is also assigned when changed.
findings.note: A diagnostic patch installed only after mount can miss captured native setter calls. Prototype instrumentation must be installed before React mounts.

findings.frequencyFromSource: Runs restoration when previously focused element differs from current focused element. setSelection at8556 uses direct selectionStart and selectionEnd property setters, not setSelectionRange.
findings.note: A setSelectionRange-only wrapper cannot observe every JS selection write. Normal unchanged focus does not enter this restoration branch.

findings.frequencyFromSource: No symbol or source file named NativeInputAdapter found under src. Relevant shared typing adapter in this review is useWordCorrection. Separate game inputs exist in src/games/ui/NativeGameInput.tsx and src/components/games/SignalRun.tsx.
findings.note: Game adapters were not audited beyond identifying them; scope is Learn and main typing/BOT native pipelines.

diagnosticPlan.installation: Init script before React mounts. Preserve and delegate native descriptors/functions exactly, including receiver, arguments, return value and errors. Restore descriptors after run. Do not patch live own React value descriptor.
observe: HTMLTextAreaElement.value setter counts and duration; record only old/new lengths or equality, never raw text
setSelectionRange and direct selectionStart/selectionEnd/selectionDirection setters; distinguish direct operation kind and capture bounded before/after offset/direction fields
focus calls/counts/options and selectionchange event counts; avoid stack captures for every character
beforeinput/input/composition markers and bounded setter start/end trace marks to associate Layout, UpdateLayoutTree, PrePaint, Paint, Layerize, EventDispatch and FunctionCall
Computed textarea dimensions, scroll extents, wrap, whiteSpace, overflow, font, and scroll offsets once outside timed window; scroll event counts within window
caveats: Instrumentation getters, markers and call wrappers perturb runtime; diagnostic latency is not acceptance latency
Native browser input does not necessarily invoke a JavaScript value/selection setter
Low wrapper self-time does not rule out deferred layout or selection-triggered native work
Correlation with setter intervals does not by itself establish causality
Use existing unchanged native sequences and candidate fingerprints; do not alter typing semantics or 3D quality

safeGuardRecommendation.reason: Ordinary accepted app-level selection setters were not found; prior negative getter/prototype results from parent reduce justification for speculative native pipeline edits.
safeGuardRecommendation.conditionalEligibility: Only if a trace proves a repeated redundant setter: skip only when native canonical value, exact UTF16 selectionStart, selectionEnd, and normalized direction already equal the intended result, and no composition boundary/focus restoration still needs the operation. Never deduce equivalence solely from controller cursor.
regressionsRequiredIfChanged: NFC prose versus exact code normalization
IME composition, duplicate composition echo, dead keys and replacement text
Forward/backward selections, middle-word edits, graphemes and RTL
Current-word correction and previous-incorrect-word reopening with correct words locked
Ctrl/Alt/Meta word deletion, noncancelable native mobile deletion
Blur/refocus WebKit last-character selection, pause/resume, restart and mobile keyboard focus
Screen reader naming, focus order and revealed native input behavior
